The '''Far Perlemian''' referred to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] stretch of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] beyond the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] and [[Estaria/Legends|Estaria]]. An impoverished region, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had little interest in the Far Perlemian in its final years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] often had free reign there. [[Folende]] was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the Tion Cluster that supplied the region with food staples.
